items.title: New price for 'Kabel 250' takes effect
items.quote: zum 01.02.2027 erhöhen wir den Preis Ihres Tarifs „Kabel 250“ um 3,00 € auf 37,99 € im Monat (bisher 34,99 €).
items.computation: Date stated explicitly in the letter: the increased price of 37.99 € (from 34.99 €) applies from 01.02.2027. No calculation needed.

items.title: Deadline to use special free termination right (price-increase cancellation)
items.quote: Sie dürfen den Vertrag deshalb innerhalb von drei Monaten nach Erhalt dieses Schreibens kostenlos und ohne Kündigungsfrist beenden, frühestens zum Wirksamwerden der Preisänderung.
items.computation: Letter dated Wed 18.11.2026. No statutory delivery presumption exists for private companies (unlike §122 AO for authorities), so I apply the same commonly-used 3-day postal fiction as an approximation: day 3 after dispatch = Sat 21.11.2026; since that is not a business day, the presumed delivery (Zugang) shifts to the next business day, Mon 23.11.2026. The 3-month period to exercise the free termination right runs 'nach Erhalt' (after receipt): per §187(1) BGB the period starts the day after Zugang (24.11.2026); per §188(2) BGB a period measured in months ends with the expiry of the day in the last month that numerically corresponds to the day of the triggering event (Zugang = the 23rd) — i.e. three months after November 23 is February 23, 2027. 23.02.2027 is a Tuesday and not a public holiday in NRW, so no further shift is needed. Note: the actual date the letter reached the customer's mailbox is unknown, so this date is an approximation.

warnings: The exact date the letter actually arrived in the customer's mailbox is not stated; the 23.11.2026 receipt date (and therefore the 23.02.2027 deadline) is only an approximation based on a typical postal-delivery assumption, not a legal certainty as it would be for an authority's letter.
The special termination can only take effect at the earliest on 01.02.2027 (when the price increase becomes effective), even if the cancellation is sent earlier within the 3-month window.
